display.purpose: Page h1, sign-in headline, lid logo sticker.

headline.purpose: Dialog titles and the sign-in card title.

title.purpose: Workspace names (Archivo), session task, empty-state titles.

body.purpose: All UI text, chat and agent turns.

label.purpose: State pills, Live pill, metadata; 800 uppercase 0.08em for rail and panel section headings.

sticker.purpose: Archivo wide and heavy: brand, avatars, lane stickers, cursor flags only.

mono.purpose: Code, status bar, timestamps, commands, file names.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Under every sticker and the active tab, tree row and version. Dark: 0 7px 16px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5).

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Cards, lanes, create form, services list are flat with a hairline border.

shadows.name: die-cut
shadows.purpose: White die-cut border composed before lift on every sticker (4px on sign-in stickers).

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Lemon halo on focused inputs, with an ink border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State transitions, 140 to 220ms: button press, row arrow, tree chevron, dialog rise.

motion.name: ease-slap
motion.purpose: Sticker slap-on: from tilt minus 10deg at 1.35x scale; 380ms in app, 520ms staggered 90ms on sign-in.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Leading dot on Live and running agents. All motion is gated by prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default white-sheet button with a strong seam; presses down 1px.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong, #a9adb4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--text, #16171a); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: var(--text, #16171a); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface, #fbfbfa), 0 0 0 4px var(--text, #16171a); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Lemon: the one primary action on a view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1.5px solid #16171a; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--signal, #ffd400); color: #16171a; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal-strong, #ffc700); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface, #fbfbfa), 0 0 0 4px var(--text, #16171a); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action; muted until hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #50545b); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--hover, #ecedef); color: var(--text, #16171a); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface, #fbfbfa), 0 0 0 4px var(--text, #16171a); }

components.name: Input
components.description: 38px field; ink border and lemon halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong, #a9adb4); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--text, #16171a); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--faint, #666a72); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--text, #16171a); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, #ffd400 70%, transparent); }

components.name: State Pills
components.description: State carried by shape: hollow idle, dot running, filled done, dashed failed, dotted struck cancelled.
components.html: queued running done failed cancelled
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 1px 9px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted, #50545b); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-run { color: var(--text, #16171a); } .ds-run::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-done { border-color: var(--text, #16171a); background: var(--text, #16171a); color: var(--surface, #fbfbfa); } .ds-fail { border-style: dashed; color: var(--down-text, #b3261e); } .ds-cancel { border-style: dotted; text-decoration: line-through; }

components.name: Live Pill
components.description: Connection state on the hinge: lemon with a pulsing dot when live, hollow dashed otherwise.
components.css: .ds-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 1px 10px; border: 1.5px solid #ffd400; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffd400; color: #16171a; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-live::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A white sheet resting on the lid.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px 18px; background: var(--surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--text, #16171a); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d4d8); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7) inset, 0 10px 30px -18px rgb(22 23 26 / 0.45); font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #50545b); }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: The graphite hinge, identical in both themes, with the tilted lemon brand sticker.
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: #1b1c20; color: #f2f2ee; border-bottom: 1px solid #34363c; font-family: 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: inline-block; padding: 0.18em 0.6em; background: #ffd400; color: #16171a; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: 125%; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2.5px #f2f2ee, 0 7px 16px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75); transform: rotate(-2.5deg); } .ds-wsname { flex: 1; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-tb-live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 1px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffd400; color: #16171a; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tb-live::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Presence Stickers
components.description: People as tilted die-cut stickers in their colour; an agent is hollow with the owner's colour as a dotted inner line.
components.html: ASBNBN
components.css: .ds-presence { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; } .ds-av { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; font-weight: 850; font-size: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2.5px #ffffff, 0 6px 14px -5px rgb(22 23 26 / 0.45), 0 1px 2px rgb(22 23 26 / 0.18); } .ds-agent { background: var(--surface, #fbfbfa); color: var(--text, #16171a); outline: 2px dotted; outline-offset: -5px; }

components.name: Budget Tape
components.description: A member's daily agent budget: a fixed-capacity ticked tape that fills in ink and cannot overflow.
components.css: .ds-tape { position: relative; width: 240px; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--active, #e2e4e8) 0 9px, var(--surface-2, #f0f1f2) 9px 10px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--border-strong, #a9adb4) inset; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tape i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--text, #16171a); border-radius: 999px; }

narrative.overview:
A Converge workspace is a laptop lid. The shell is the lid itself: brushed aluminium in light, graphite in dark, with a graphite hinge (top bar and status bar) that never changes between themes. The open file sits on it as the flattest, quietest sheet. Everything that is a *who* (a person, an agent, a lane owner, a remote cursor, the brand) is a die-cut vinyl sticker slapped onto that lid: a flat saturated colour, a white die-cut border, a soft lift shadow, and a small tilt that is fixed per identity so the same person always sits on the lid the same way.

Colour is owned, not decorative. Six sticker colours belong to people; lemon belongs only to primary actions and Live; everything else is graphite, aluminium and white. State is never carried by borrowing someone's colour: it is carried by shape (filled, hollow, dashed, dotted, struck through). Density is IDE-dense in the working rails and generous only on sign-in, where the lid itself is the brand moment. The system rejects the grey IDE with one blue accent and the gradient-banner SaaS look; it replaced a cyanotype world the owner judged generic.
keyCharacteristics: A lid, a hinge and sheets: three planes, and stickers on top of them.
Six person colours, one lemon signal, everything else achromatic.
State by shape: filled is done, hollow is idle, dot is live, dashed is pending or down, dotted is cancelled or denied.
One type scale (12 / 14 / 17 / 22 / 30); rank by weight and case, not by new sizes.
Archivo, wide and heavy, only on stickers, the brand and the workspace name.

rules.name: The Owned Colour Rule
rules.body: A sticker colour means a person and nothing else. Never use one for a status, a category, a button or a highlight.

rules.name: The Lemon Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Lemon marks the primary action and Live. If two lemon things compete on one screen that are not the brand sticker and Live, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Shape Carries State Rule
rules.body: Status is told by fill, outline style and strike: filled = done or decided, hollow = idle or waiting, leading dot = running or live (pulsing), dashed = pending, gotcha, warning or down, dotted = cancelled, denied or expired, struck = cancelled or failed tool. Red text may accompany a dashed shape; it never carries state alone.

rules.name: The Five Sizes Rule
rules.body: 12, 14, 17, 22, 30. A new level of emphasis comes from weight (600 / 700 / 750 / 800) or case, never from a new size.

rules.name: The Archivo Is Vinyl Rule
rules.body: Archivo appears only on stickers, the brand and the workspace name. Body copy and controls never use it.

rules.name: The Only Stickers Lift Rule
rules.body: An element casts a shadow or tilts only if it is a sticker (an identity or the brand). A pill always means a state; plain labels are text.

dos: **Do** give every person and agent a sticker: colour from `colorFor`, ink from `inkFor`, tilt from `tiltFor`, white die cut and Lift.
**Do** mark agents as hollow stickers with the owner's colour as a dashed or dotted inner line.
**Do** carry state by shape (filled, hollow, dot, dashed, dotted, struck) so it reads in greyscale.
**Do** keep the hinge (`hinge-graphite`) identical in light and dark.
**Do** stay on the 12 / 14 / 17 / 22 / 30 scale and rank by weight.
**Do** wrap every motion in `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`; slaps use `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`, everything else `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` at 140 to 220ms.
donts: **Don't** use a sticker colour for a status, a category or a button.
**Don't** use lemon for anything but primary actions, Live, the brand, selection and link underlines.
**Don't** set body copy or controls in Archivo.
**Don't** add shadows to anything that is neither a sticker nor a sheet.
**Don't** rebuild the grey IDE with a single blue accent, or a gradient-banner SaaS header.
**Don't** tilt sheets, controls or text; only stickers tilt.
